jobs.title: Full-Stack Engineer (Internal Tools)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
The Role

Ziina is looking for a Full-Stack Engineer to join our Platform team and help build the internal tools that power our operations.

You will improve and extend the tools our teams use today while helping us gradually bring our back-office platform in-house. This includes understanding complex operational processes, integrating with our existing third-party solution, and building intuitive workflows that enable teams to operate safely and efficiently.

As our team is small, our ideal candidate is a creative thinker who enjoys understanding how a business operates and translating ambiguous requirements into reliable software. They can move quickly, clearly articulate tradeoffs, and independently own features from discovery through production.

We are ambitious about building internal platforms that scale with the company, and we’d love to bring on someone who shares that ambition.

As a Full-Stack Engineer on the Platform team at Ziina, you will:

  • Collaborate with operations, compliance, risk, customer support, product, and engineering teams to understand workflows and identify opportunities for better tooling and automation.

  • Improve and extend the workflows supported by our existing third-party back-office solution, including building the integrations and supporting services it requires.

  • Help define and incrementally build Ziina’s in-house back-office platform, taking features from discovery and design through implementation, rollout, and iteration.

  • Turn complex operational processes into intuitive and reliable experiences with appropriate permissions, safeguards, and auditability.

  • Establish consistent patterns for internal interfaces and service integrations, while ensuring critical workflows are tested, monitored, and resilient to failure.

To succeed in this role, you likely:

  • Have 4+ years of full-stack development experience and are comfortable working across web applications, APIs, backend services, and relational databases.

  • Enjoy understanding operational workflows and solving problems for internal users.

  • Bring clarity and structure to ambiguous requirements and can independently drive work forward.

  • Balance delivery speed with security, reliability, and maintainability.

  • Communicate clearly with technical and non-technical collaborators and demonstrate high integrity and a team-first mindset.

  • Are based in, or open to relocating to, the UAE.

What would amaze us

  • Deep proficiency with React, Next.js, and TypeScript, with strong experience building backend services using Node.js and Nest.js.

  • Experience building internal tools, administrative platforms, operational dashboards, or workflow-management systems.

  • Experience designing permissions, approval workflows, audit logs, and other controls for sensitive operations.

  • Experience with GraphQL, PostgreSQL, Kafka, and event-driven or asynchronous workflows.

  • An AI-forward mindset, with experience using AI-assisted development tools and applying AI to simplify or automate operational workflows.

Our tech stack

We’ve built a modular architecture with reliability, scalability, and maintainability in mind. Our current stack is:

  • TypeScript, Node.js, Nest.js, Next.js, and React.

  • GraphQL Federation and Kafka.

  • PostgreSQL, Redis, and Elasticsearch.

  • AWS, Kubernetes, and Terraform.

  • GitHub Actions for CI/CD.

jobs.title: Head of Internal Audit
jobs.descriptionHtml:
The Role

We're looking for an independent, hands-on, and forward-thinking Head of Internal Audit to establish and lead Ziina's Internal Audit function.

As our first dedicated Internal Audit hire, you'll have the opportunity to build the function from the ground up, define its approach, and deliver independent assurance across our existing regulated operations and future regulated entities as Ziina expands.

You'll operate with significant autonomy and direct access to the Board of Directors, owning audit planning, execution, and reporting while working closely with teams across the business and maintaining the independence required of the function.

We're looking for someone who combines strong fintech audit experience with a pragmatic, technology-driven mindset. Someone who understands regulatory expectations, identifies meaningful risks, leverages data and automation, and builds effective audit practices without introducing unnecessary bureaucracy.

This is an opportunity to shape a modern Internal Audit function within a fast-growing fintech, with broad business exposure and meaningful influence over the Company's governance and control environment.

As a Head of Internal Audit at Ziina, you will:

  • Build and lead the Internal Audit function from the ground up, establishing its charter, methodology, policies, procedures, and governance framework in line with CBUAE requirements and applicable professional standards.

  • Develop and execute a risk-based Internal Audit Plan, independently assessing the effectiveness of governance, risk management, and internal controls across Ziina's regulated activities.

  • Conduct end-to-end audits, including planning, risk assessment, control testing, evidence evaluation, reporting, and remediation follow-up, initially operating as a standalone function.

  • Provide independent assurance across financial, operational, regulatory, and technology risks, including payments, AML/CFT, consumer protection, safeguarding of customer funds, outsourcing, cybersecurity, and data protection.

  • Leverage data analytics and automation to enhance audit testing, identify anomalies, assess controls at scale, and reduce manual processes, collaborating with Engineering and Data teams where relevant.

  • Provide independent reporting and insights to the Board, highlighting material risks, control deficiencies, audit findings, and remediation progress through clear, objective, and actionable recommendations.

  • Challenge stakeholders constructively, identifying root causes and recommending practical improvements while maintaining independence from management and operational decision-making.

  • Oversee audit findings and remediation, establishing appropriate tracking mechanisms, monitoring management's corrective actions, and independently validating their effectiveness.

  • Coordinate regulatory and external assurance activities with CBUAE, external auditors, and independent reviewers on matters within the Internal Audit function's remit.

  • Extend audit coverage to new regulated entities, adapting the audit approach to evolving business activities, products, jurisdictions, and applicable regulatory requirements.

  • Continuously improve audit effectiveness, introducing scalable processes, technology-enabled testing, and proportionate governance practices that support Ziina's growth.

To succeed in this role, you likely:

  • Have 7+ years of Internal Audit experience, including direct, hands-on experience auditing fintech companies, preferably within payments, digital financial services, or technology-driven regulated financial institutions.

  • Have a strong understanding of risk-based auditing, internal controls, corporate governance, and the IIA Global Internal Audit Standards.

  • Have experience operating within CBUAE-regulated environments or comparable financial regulatory frameworks, with the ability to understand and apply UAE regulatory requirements.

  • Hold a relevant professional qualification such as CIA, CPA, ACCA, or an equivalent recognized certification.

  • Have demonstrated experience developing audit plans, executing control testing, identifying findings, and communicating results to senior leadership or Board-level stakeholders.

  • Are comfortable establishing and operating a function independently, taking ownership of both strategic priorities and hands-on execution.

  • Understand technology-driven financial services and can assess risks across operational processes, financial crime controls, IT systems, and regulatory obligations.

  • Bring strong analytical skills and an interest in leveraging data, technology, and automation to improve audit effectiveness.

  • Exercise sound professional judgment, prioritize material risks, and deliver practical recommendations without unnecessary complexity.

  • Communicate clearly, challenge constructively, and build effective relationships across teams while maintaining professional independence.

  • Thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment where ownership, adaptability, and execution are essential.

What would amaze us:

  • You've previously established or transformed an Internal Audit function, particularly within a fintech or high-growth regulated business.

  • You've personally developed automated audit tests, used SQL, Python, Power BI, or similar tools, or implemented data-driven audit methodologies.

  • You've introduced continuous auditing or monitoring approaches that improved risk detection, audit coverage, or operational efficiency.

  • You've audited payment platforms, digital financial products, AML/CFT systems, or technology infrastructure.

  • You've worked across multiple regulated entities or jurisdictions and successfully adapted audit frameworks to different regulatory requirements.

  • You're known for combining independent judgment, strong technical expertise, and a practical, solutions-oriented approach.

  • You've demonstrated the ability to build effective audit capabilities with lean resources, focusing on quality, meaningful risk coverage, and measurable outcomes.

Important Regulatory Requirement

This position is subject to the prior approval of the Central Bank of the UAE (CBUAE). The selected candidate must satisfy all applicable regulatory eligibility, fit-and-proper, and suitability requirements. The appointment and commencement of regulated duties will be conditional upon obtaining the required CBUAE approval.

jobs.title: Backend Engineer, Payments Platform
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Ziina is looking for a Backend Engineer to join our team. We laid a strong foundation upon which we’ve shipped our product. We are looking for someone to help us build out innovative new features, prepare our technology to scale, and help shape our engineering organization to be the kind of place that bright minds from across the region and the world aspire to work for.

As our team is small, our ideal candidate is a creative thinker excited to solve hard problems and to build something from the ground up. They can move quickly, clearly articulate tradeoffs, and have the judgement to own features independently. They are obsessive about delivering great, high quality products to our users. We are ambitious and excited to build big things, and we’d love to bring on someone who is as well. In short, we are looking for owners.

 

As a Backend Engineer at Ziina you will:

  • Collaborate with world-class product, design, operations, and engineering teams to determine which features and solutions will deliver the most value for the business and the best experience for our users

  • Own and ship end-to-end reliable, scalable, and maintainable software that will keep our users’ funds safe and stand the test of time. You will take features from design, to implementation, to polish, to shipping, to monitoring and measuring progress

  • Design and build a cloud-native platform while leveraging the main features for monitoring, observability, security, scalability, elasticity, and testing

  • Improve CI/CD workflows to reduce time-to-market for new features

  • Help shape our engineering culture by introducing good practices and methods of knowledge-sharing

Key skills and characteristics

  • Be an owner and a team player

  • Be curious and eager to grow

  • Be able to define and effectively communicate technical and design requirements

  • Be able to write clean, high-quality, testable, reusable, and well-documented code

  • Possess strong data-driven thinking and customer focus

  • Possess excellent communication skills and a desire to collaborate

  • Live in, or be willing to relocate to the UAE

What would amaze us

  • 3+ years developing software

  • Experience working on systems that handle money

  • Experience with Node.js, GraphQL, Postgres, ElasticSearch, or Kafka

  • Experience shipping and maintaining complex backends

Our tech stack

We’ve built a modular architecture with the principles of reliability, scalability, and maintainability in mind. Our current stack is:

  • Typescript, Node.js and Nest.js for our main application’s backend

  • Swift/SwiftUI for our iOS app, Kotlin for our Android app

  • Next.js, React and Typescript for our web applications

  • GraphQL Federation for our client-facing APIs and Kafka for our inter-service communication

  • PostgresSQL for consistent and durable storage, Redis for quick fetching, Elasticsearch for quick searching

  • AWS for hosting our cloud infrastructure and Kubernetes for orchestrating our workloads

  • Terraform for IaC

  • Github Actions for CI/CD

jobs.title: Head of Marketing
jobs.descriptionHtml:
The Role

Ziina is searching for a dynamic Head of Marketing to lead our strategic product-led growth initiatives. This includes product marketing, brand awareness, customer acquisition, and revenue growth.

This role is ideal for a data-driven, creative leader who can develop and execute impactful marketing strategies while inspiring a high-performing team. We are seeking a versatile marketing leader with a full-stack background, with deep expertise in product marketing—including positioning, messaging, and go-to-market execution—while also combining creative flair with analytical acumen to position Ziina as the go-to payments solution in the region. The ideal candidate should have a track record of success in both startup environments and scaling organizations.

This is simultaneously a hands-on role while leading a phenomenal team of passionate high performers. We expect this role to lead by example by rolling their sleeves up and diving into the details including how every pixel aligns on the latest ad.

As a Head of Marketing at Ziina you will:

  • Own product positioning and messaging strategy, translating Ziina's payment features into compelling customer benefits that drive adoption and differentiate us in the fintech market.

  • Lead comprehensive go-to-market execution for new product launches, coordinating cross-functional teams and establishing measurable success metrics for user adoption and retention.

  • Build data-driven quarterly marketing roadmaps aligned with company growth objectives, including strategic budget allocation across channels and initiatives.

  • Drive multi-channel customer acquisition through paid media, content marketing, social media, and partnership strategies while optimizing for healthy CAC payback periods.

  • Establish and maintain marketing analytics frameworks to continuously optimize campaign performance, forecast business impact, and inform strategic decision-making.

  • Craft Ziina's brand narrative and storytelling that positions us as the go-to payments solution in the region through high-quality, creative content.

  • Build and lead a high-performing marketing team, providing coaching, setting clear goals, and fostering a culture of excellence, creativity, and data-driven results.

  • Facilitate seamless cross-functional collaboration with product, sales, and executive teams to ensure alignment on messaging, goals, and strategic initiatives.

  • Conduct customer research and competitive analysis to inform product positioning, messaging frameworks, and marketing strategies that resonate with target audiences.

  • Manage marketing budgets strategically, allocating resources across channels and campaigns to achieve maximum ROI and sustainable, scalable growth.

  • Oversee creative asset development with strong aesthetic vision, ensuring all marketing materials maintain brand consistency and premium quality standards.

  • Select and manage external vendor relationships, including agencies and consultants, while maintaining high delivery standards and alignment with marketing objectives.

To succeed in this role you likely have:

  • 7+ years of progressive marketing experience with a proven track record of scaling growth in startup or high-growth environments, including demonstrated success in product marketing leadership roles

  • Strategic thinking beyond immediate needs, developing and implementing medium to long-term marketing strategies that scale effectively as the business grows

  • Deep go-to-market expertise, with experience driving successful product launches and scaling user adoption across multiple channels and customer segments

  • Experience in leading and inspiring teams, with strong mentorship skills and a focus on empowering team members to achieve peak performance and professional growth

  • High data fluency, with expertise in marketing analytics and a demonstrated ability to use metrics for forecasting, optimization, and strategic decision-making

  • The ability to combine creative flair with growth mindset, bringing natural aesthetic sense and innovative thinking to develop tailored marketing solutions that drive results

  • Confidence and decisiveness, comfortable pushing back when necessary and prioritizing initiatives that align with long-term brand vision and business objectives

  • Exceptional communication skills, with strong verbal and written skills that enable you to engage stakeholders and convey complex marketing concepts clearly

  • Resilience and problem-solving ability, with a proactive, organized approach to overcoming challenges and managing risks in a fast-paced environment

  • Passion for fintech innovation, with genuine excitement about shaping the future of payments in the Middle East through creative, data-driven marketing
